verbatim_quote.original: disable for dev, keep for prod
verbatim_quote.english_translation: disable for dev, keep for prod

extracted_decision.summary: CSP upgrade-insecure-requests disabled on dev, kept on prod.
extracted_decision.rationale: Dev is served over plain http on a public IP where the directive breaks login; prod terminates TLS so the hardening stays.
alternatives: Keep globally and fix dev TLS
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Dev convenience vs keeping prod security posture intact.
